ms.name: Mississippi (statewide)
ms.bounds: Every Mississippi migratory game bird season is statewide.
ms.note: One zone. Public areas may have their own dates, hours and closed areas.

seasonsNote: Every season is statewide. Public waterfowl areas (WMAs, NWRs, Corps lakes) may set different dates, hours and closed areas.

seasons.label: Canada geese — September
seasons.note: Roebuck Lake (Leflore County) is closed to Canada goose hunting.

seasons.label: Canada geese — regular
seasons.note: Brant and white-fronted geese with the same dates. Roebuck Lake closed to Canada geese.

seasons.label: Light geese
seasons.note: Snow, blue and Ross’s geese. Light Goose Conservation Order (free permit): Oct 1 – Nov 12, Nov 30 – Dec 3, Feb 1–5 and Feb 8 – Mar 31.

seasons.label: Veterans and active military waterfowl days

rules.d: One-half hour before sunrise to sunset for all migratory game birds; light geese to 30 minutes after sunset during the Conservation Order.
Federal rules: approved non-toxic shot for waterfowl; shotguns plugged to 3 shells (except the Conservation Order).
Roebuck Lake (Leflore County) is closed to Canada goose hunting. Amber on the map.
WMAs, national wildlife refuges and Corps lakes may have different dates, hours and closed areas; check each area. State-line waters: reciprocal licence agreements with Arkansas and Louisiana.

rules.t: Youth, veterans and active military days

rules.d: Leave the head or one fully feathered wing on until you get home, and tag birds left with anyone else (federal rules).

licences.d: Electronic or physical (sign the physical stamp); valid one year from purchase.

geometryNote: Geometry: public land from USFWS’s Mississippi Alluvial Valley state-managed lands (the Delta only — MDWFP publishes no WMA GIS); boat ramps from OpenStreetMap; USGS NHD (water; streams from the NHD small-scale layer) and GNIS; USFWS (refuge units; NWI marsh); NOAA CO-OPS (tides); Census TIGER (outline, county subdivisions, borders). One statewide zone.
